cohort: Use catalogue_arrays.npz produced by replay.py after result.json passed=true.
native_binding: Build the native core/competitive libraries in an output directory using the repository Stage-2 build instructions; set INHIBITORY_S06_NATIVE_DIR. Source/ABI/toolchain checks are separate from raw data replay.
primary_steps: Load the regenerated NPZ with allow_pickle=False into a mapping of all arrays.
For fold 0,1,2 load primary/nuisance/f{fold}.json and primary/selected/f{fold}.json from the bundle. The selected state for each arm stores sigma and selected.x.
Use start=3652/4748/5844 and end=4748/5844/6940. Choose family=competitive for N0/EP, lift for FL/OL, continuous for FC/MC/OC.
Call engine.features(cohort,nuisance,start,end,selected_sigma,family), then engine.save_cache into a fresh output path. Caches are recomputed from event records; do not substitute saved score totals.

Use engine.Objective(cache).evaluate(arm,selected_vector,fine=False,detailed=True). Compare every event log, integrated-intensity component, mark score and joint/timing/location summary with the corresponding primary/scores/f{fold}_{arm}_full.json/.npz.

Repeat the nine annual blocks with their exact source-JST boundaries if reproducing the annual tables. Candidate_forecasts retains all finite candidate returns and permits independent selection/stability inspection.

Recomputing scores at saved parameters is a frozen-vector replay. Full refitting additionally requires the complete preserved 36-procedure/330-slot roster, eight starts, exact floors, failed-return lineage, training-only selection and original recovery rules.
s06_steps: The primary dfree states are the original selected FC/OC/EP states. S06 d0 fitted vectors are in s06/JMA_fold_{fold}/fits/d0_{arm}.json; nuisances and case configuration are in the same case directory.
Use the same catalogue/fold bounds and explicitly zero the trend coordinate according to the preserved S06 protocol; compare the bundled d0 and dfree event-score files and receipt rows.
The saved protocols use sanitized historical artifact identifiers. Create current runtime/file bindings rather than treating those archive identifiers as paths or rewriting the historical hashes.
limits: Raw replay does not call this numerical recipe, estimate nuisance parameters, refit or certify forecasting scores. Full numerical replay must state its actual checks and tolerances.
